bugs.summary: List-view rows now pass only promRule to RuleActionsButtons, so for a Grafana alerting rule the menu shows 'Silence notifications' (enabled by the new prom-rule abilities) but the drawer is gated on a ruler rule that is never present, and clicking it does nothing.
bugs.evidence: GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx:47 `<RuleActionsButtons promRule={rule} groupIdentifier={groupIdentifier} compact />` (no rule). AlertRuleMenu.tsx:94-96 `canSilence = ... || (grafanaSilenceSupported && grafanaSilenceAllowed)` and :126-131 render the item with onClick=handleSilence; useAbilities.ts:323 `[AlertRuleAction.Silence]: [silenceSupported, canSilenceInFolder && isAlertingRule]` for prom rules. RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:104-105 (unchanged by the PR) `{rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer && <SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer rulerRule={rule} .../>}`; utils/rules.ts:58-63 isGrafanaRulerRule(undefined) is false, and SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer.tsx:11-12 requires `rulerRule: RulerGrafanaRuleDTO`. Upstream main later replaced the gate with `silenceableRule` and `ruleUid`. Golden comment (Martian grafana.json). No round-1 or round-2 finding targeted this site.

bugs.summary: The PR drops the key prop when FilterView renders GrafanaRuleListItem inside rules.map, so React warns and reconciles Grafana rows by index as filter results stream in.
bugs.evidence: FilterView.tsx:151-163 `rules.map(...) case 'grafana': return (<GrafanaRuleListItem rule={rule} ... />)` with no key; the removed GrafanaRuleLoader had `key={key}`, and the sibling cases at :165 and :169 still pass `key={key}`. Golden comment. Matches R2 composite-medium, v-code-field-high, v-grounding-medium.

bugs.summary: In the list view the Pause/Resume and Delete menu items disappear for Grafana rules: canPause/canDelete are now computed from the prom rule, but both items still require a ruler rule, which list rows no longer pass.
bugs.evidence: AlertRuleMenu.tsx:81-83 canPause includes grafanaPauseAbility; :123 `{canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) && ...}` (unchanged) with rulerRule undefined from GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx:47 -> RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:95. Before the PR GrafanaRuleLoader passed `rule={rulerRule}`, so the item showed. Likely rather than certain: dropping pause could be an accepted cost of removing ruler calls, but the PR computes the prom pause ability, and upstream main later gated the item on `ruleUid` instead. Delete is the same: AlertRuleMenu.tsx:87 canDelete includes grafanaDeleteAbility, :165 `{canDelete && rulerRule && (` hides it; upstream main now renders `{canDelete && (` and gates pause on `ruleUid`. The PR's own GrafanaGroupLoader.test.tsx:206 asserts exactly 4 menu items although the test grants delete permission, which encodes this loss (the cluster of 'menu item count ignores Delete' findings matches this entry).

bugs.summary: useAllAlertRuleAbilities (used for CombinedRule by the v1 list and rule viewer via useAlertRuleAbility) now delegates to useAllRulerRuleAbilities, whose isFederated is hard-coded false, so rules in Mimir federated rule groups (source_tenants) become editable, deletable and pausable where they were immutable before.
bugs.evidence: Removed line in useAllAlertRuleAbilities: `const isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group);` feeding `immutableRule = isProvisioned || isFederated || isPluginProvided`. Head useAbilities.ts:227-228 `return useAllRulerRuleAbilities(rule.rulerRule, groupIdentifierV2)` and :244-245 `// const isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(); const isFederated = false;` (with a TODO). The isFederatedRuleGroup import is removed. Likely rather than certain: upstream main still has the TODO and isFederated=false, so the maintainers may accept the gap, but the PR description does not mention dropping it.

bugs.summary: The Grafana rule list item's view link drops the returnTo parameter the removed GrafanaRuleListItem added, so the back button on a Grafana rule's page goes to the unfiltered /alerting/list instead of the filtered list the user came from (datasource rows still pass returnTo).
bugs.evidence: Removed GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx: `const returnTo = createReturnTo();` ... `href: createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`, { returnTo })`. Head GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx:40 `href: createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`)`. RuleViewer.tsx:96 `const { returnTo } = useReturnTo('/alerting/list')` feeds the back LinkButton (:123, :304). DataSourceRuleListItem.tsx:36-42 still builds the link with createReturnTo(). Likely rather than certain: upstream main still omits returnTo for Grafana rows, so it may be an accepted simplification.

bugs.summary: For non-Grafana rules AlertRuleMenu passes skipToken, but useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined) still reports Duplicate as supported and allowed whenever the user holds the Grafana alert.rules:create permission; OR-ed into canDuplicate, the Duplicate item now shows for datasource rules the ruler path denies (no ruler, or no external-write permission).
bugs.evidence: useAbilities.ts:354-355 useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable(undefined) returns loading:false; :309 `MaybeSupported = loading ? NotSupported : AlwaysSupported`; :313 duplicateSupported = MaybeSupported; :318 `[Duplicate]: toAbility(duplicateSupported, rulesPermissions.create)` with getRulesPermissions('grafana'). AlertRuleMenu.tsx:91-92 `canDuplicate = (duplicateSupported && duplicateAllowed) || (grafanaDuplicateSupported && grafanaDuplicateAllowed)`. Ruler path for a datasource rule: duplicateSupported = isRulerAvailable (:253,:257) and the external-write permission. Upstream later rewrote this as usePromRuleAdministrationAbility, which returns NotSupported for every action on skipToken (hooks/abilities/rules/promRuleAbilities.ts:55-62). Matches R2 v-sweep-medium, v-grounding-low/high, 01-medium, v-code-field-high, composite-low, 22-medium (Duplicate fail-open).
